prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding tips and a timer to waiting screens was helpful (+8.9%, p=0.0008), closely matching predictions (+8.0%).
Redesigning the path choice screen was helpful (+12.0%, p=0.0), far exceeding the prediction (+1.0%).
New flows can be harmful; a post-setup launcher flow significantly reduced completion (-19.6%, p=0.001), while other new flows showed no clear effect.
Adding new screens, path hints, copy changes, step reordering, status indicators, notification toggles, and animations showed no clear effect.
Predictions for path choice redesign were far too low, while predictions for new flows, new screens, step reordering, hints, and copy changes were consistently too high.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +5.9% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: -4.8% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +3.7% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -2.5% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +12.0% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -6.4% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -2.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.2% over 4 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: -1.1% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.3% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 83.9%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, redesign] Spotlight Layout for Pet Generation Screen: Redesign the pet generation waiting screen into a spotlight layout that focuses user attention on active pet generation progress. (why: The waiting screen has a very long median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-offs before final launch.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Carousel Layout Pet Choice Selection: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a carousel layout to showcase selectable pets in a focused, interactive visual format. (why: Adoption stage conversion drops to 60.9% with a median time of 89s; a carousel layout streamlines pet selection.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Customization Style Preview Screen: Insert a new style preview screen before photo upload to display visual style examples of generated custom pets. (why: Support receives emails regarding custom pet generation failing or looking wrong (3 emails), so setting style expectations upfront helps users.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Post Adoption Certificate Sign In Flow: Reorder the sign-in step to occur after adoption certificate completion instead of before pet selection. (why: Sign-in drops 27.1% of users early; placing sign-in after pet selection leverages user commitment to complete account creation.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Story Scroll Layout for Intro Screen: Update the story screen to use a story_scroll layout for smoother reading of background lore. (why: The mean time spent on choose_path step is high (514s), indicating users linger or get stuck on the story screen.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop Taskbar Tray Control Hint: Add a hint to the home intro screen showing users how to control or hide their pet using the system taskbar tray icon. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries about how to control, hide, or interact with the pet after completing setup (3 emails).)
6: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Pet Retrieval Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to advise returning users to log in with their original account method to keep pets. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) concerns pets missing or reset after signing in with a different account method.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Sound Notification: Add an audio component to the waiting screen that plays a gentle chime when pet generation finishes. (why: With high mean waiting times (2336s), users switch away from the app while waiting and benefit from an audible alert when ready.)
8: [finish, incentive] First Day Interaction Badge Reward: Add a visual adoption badge component on the home_intro screen celebrating successful completion of pet adoption. (why: Only 64.8% of users complete the finish step; adding a celebratory badge creates positive closure.)

scores.note: Targets long wait time (2336s mean); waiting screen improvements have shown success but redesigns vary.

Addresses high mean time on choose_path (514s); path choice improvements generally perform well.
Strong support mail and finish step drop-off, but hints historically yield no clear effect (-2.5%).
Top support theme (8 emails) and low cost, but copy changes consistently show no positive effect (-1.1%).
Re-engages users during long mean wait (2336s); waiting screen enhancements showed positive results (+8.9%).
